cases.reason: Explicit request to validate a named Codex skill.
Auditing a skill workflow and its steps is within the stated scope.
Reviewing ceremonial skill instructions is an explicit trigger.
Assessing an edited skill's resources and behavior is within scope.
Revalidating a builder-generated skill is assessment of a generated skill.
General explanation of Codex skills does not request validation or assessment of a skill.
Building a new skill is creation rather than validation of a skill.
Application parser repair does not validate a Codex skill.
Repository CI configuration is not skill validation.
A shopping application's product specification is unrelated to establishing or revising a skill specification during validation.
Inspecting a development skill's instruction organization before adoption is an assessment of the skill's instructions.
